blocks.html: TAGUIG CITY - QUBE Smart Technology Corp. and Robinsons Offices announced a new collaboration during a contract-signing event held recently at work.able Exxa-Zeta Center Townhall. The shared vision will usher in the future of security, efficiency, and convenience into the customer-centric and future-ready Robinsons Offices.

The collaboration was formalized to improve productivity and sharpen synergies in the workplaces, destination estates of Robinsons Land Corporation, and affiliated companies within the Gokongwei Group.

"We at QUBE value all the stakeholders by ensuring that everything is provided with different solutions," says Elcid Lao, President and CEO of QUBE. Mr. Lao also added that as QUBE bridges all the gaps between the riders, the customers, and property management, they intend to link them with using the lockers in any given scenario.

"Time is the most precious commodity in the entire universe. We want to value that time, and with time, these lockers will be able to provide efficiency not just for the riders but also for property management and customer convenience," Lao also mentioned.

During the contract signing, Jericho P. Go, President and CEO of RL Commercial REIT, Inc., was able to share his insights on the office of the future and how the collaboration with QUBE will impact Robinsons Offices, who is a lead developer of office buildings. "We want to increase efficiency, productivity, and security, and we found all those aspects in QUBE, making life much simpler and easier for our occupants."

Mr. Go further elaborated that because of these smart lockers, "you don't have to rush to pick up your parcels or documents or the items you have been waiting to be delivered to your office while probably in a meeting or even during you can be assured that the Smart Lockers of QUBE will be available 24/7, 365 days a year."

"We are grateful for this partnership because, at the same time, we realized that when QUBE offered us this technology, it was so flexible and scalable that almost anything and everything we could think of in the future, whether its registration through QR Code, remote payment, you have it practically covered for the convenience of our customers," Mr. Go added.

QUBE will play a pivotal role in the innovation initiatives of Robinsons Offices, renowned for its modern world-class, sustainable green office spaces catering to Fortune 500 Companies, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Local and Multinational Corporations in the country.

QUBE, the Philippines' First Digital Smart Locker Technology, will provide enhanced personal storage for occupants' belongings, hassle-free parcel reception to reduce interruptions or missed deliveries, efficient and effortless food delivery solutions to prevent food theft, secure document storage to avoid unauthorized access, elevated guest experience for comfort and security, advertising platforms with digital ad spaces available for office and retail tenants.
The Digital Smart Lockers will be targeted for deployment within the final quarter of 2023.
QUBE Smart Technology Corp. is an IoT-Based company that provides innovative solutions for seamless, sustainable, and convenient customer convenience.
It also initiates the advancement of technology through software and hardware research and development while linking with various industry partners for a future-proof collaboration.

Robinsons Offices is the office development arm of Robinsons Land Corporation and is a leading provider of quality offices with over 760,000 sqm of leasable office area spread across Central Business Districts, transit-oriented mixed-use developments, Destination Estates, as well as key cities across the country.

Furthermore, the Company continues to provide flexible workspace solutions under its brand, work.able. Robinsons Offices' projects are designed and developed by seasoned professionals according to world-class standards, offering locators the best-in-class client management and a work environment to propel business growth.
